revisions.author: Susanto
revisions.description: CR: Finish Order acceptance by VPLD Transportation Management. New status Waiting TM Acceptance between Start Daily Order and Finish Daily Order (Finish Order by driver / LP Admin); new role VPLD TM; Accept Finish Order per row, from Order Detail and in bulk with confirmation; Order Status filter, Waiting TM Acceptance counter and row highlight; columns Finish Scan / Accepted By / Accepted Date; Data Map [CR] blocks 11-12 and Finish Order status changed; messages no. 31-37, logs no. 6-7; Open Points OP-CR-01..07; DCR-44. Changed parts marked [CR].

revisions.author: Susanto
revisions.description: CR: Edit & Approve finish order by VPLD Transportation Management. Status renamed Waiting TM Approval; VPLD TM can Edit the delivery data (truck, driver, container, cycle times, finish time, remarks; Edit Reason mandatory; edit history before / after) and Approve (per row, Order Detail, bulk); after approval Finish Daily Order and locked; editable-field table 5.6.8; columns Finish Scan / Edited / Approved By / Approved Date; Data Map [CR] blocks 11-15; messages no. 31-43, logs no. 6-8; Open Points OP-CR-01..10; screenshots 10-18. Supersedes the 0.6 acceptance design: status Waiting TM Acceptance -> Waiting TM Approval, Accept -> Approve, DCR-44 columns TM_ACCEPT_* -> TM_APPROVE_BY / TM_APPROVE_DATE + TM_EDIT_BY / TM_EDIT_DATE. Changed parts marked [CR].

objective: To monitor daily orders (DTP) per date, location and DTP type together with the status of every cycle (Cycle 1 - Cycle 5).
To display the order detail per cycle: truck, driver, route, Container Number, activity time and supporting files (Foto Surat Jalan, Finish Cycle Foto, Surat Jalan ELIPS).
To let IELP Admin assign an order to a truck number (Order Release) and trigger the SA / PAS process.
To let Supplier with LP Admin access process their own orders manually: Order Release -> Pickup Container -> Finish Cycle -> Finish Order.
To restrict Supplier users to their own data only and keep a status history (who, when, from/to status, reason) for every status change.

[CR] To let VPLD Transportation Management (VPLD TM) check, correct (Edit) and approve the delivery data after the driver scans Finish Order (or LP Admin finishes it): the order waits in status Waiting TM Approval and becomes Finish Daily Order - locked, and sent to SA Approval - only after the TM approval.

screen_mode_remarks: 1) A workflow button is displayed only when the login role is allowed to do the action AND the current Order Status / Cycle Status allows it (Operation Description 5.5).
2) View 'Foto Surat Jalan' is enabled after Pickup Container; View 'Finish Cycle Foto' after Finish Cycle; Surat Jalan ELIPS and PDF after Start Cycle.
3) IELP Admin sees all orders. Supplier (Viewer / LP Admin) sees only orders whose Trucking Company is the login supplier.

4) [CR] VPLD TM: the selection check box, [Edit] and [Approve] are shown only for orders Waiting TM Approval; [Approve Finish Order (n)] is enabled when at least one row is selected. After approval (Finish Daily Order) Edit / Approve are not shown (locked). Other roles (incl. Planner VPLD of SA Approval) see the data read only.

operation.text: 5.1 Access Control
The data scope and allowed actions follow the login user role:

rows: Assign Truck, Process to SA, Process to PAS
Order Release, Pickup Container, Finish Cycle, Finish Order (Reason mandatory)
Orders of the truck used at login
Edit Finish Order and Approve Finish Order (orders Waiting TM Approval); no other action

operation.text: [CR] Only VPLD TM can edit or approve a Finish Order. Planner VPLD (SA Approval), IELP Admin, Supplier and Driver see Waiting TM Approval orders read only (no check box / Edit / Approve); a request from another role gets message no. 35.
The supplier restriction applies to the Order List, search, paging total, Export and Order Detail. Opening an order outside the scope shows message no. 4.
5.2 Search Operation
5.2.1 Initial Display
'Date From' = system date, 'Date To' blank, 'From Loc.' / 'To Loc.' = <Select>, Tab = ALL, Search box blank.
Order List shows orders within the user data scope matching the initial criteria, sorted by No. Order ascending, 10 rows per page.
'Last Sync at' shows the data load time.
5.2.2 Button Operation
User clicks 'Find'.

items: If Date From and Date To are filled and Date From > Date To, display message no. 1. Stop.
Retrieve orders by Date From, Date To, From Loc., To Loc., selected DTP tab and Search text within the user data scope.
If there is no data retrieved, show empty grid with message no. 2.

operation.text: User clicks 'Clear': reset all criteria (including Search) and show all orders within the user data scope.
User clicks a DTP tab: filter by DTP Type; ALL = no filter. Key-in on 'Search' filters immediately.
User clicks 'Refresh': reload the list with latest data and update 'Last Sync at'.
User clicks a column header: sort by that column; click again to reverse. Order Status sorts by workflow sequence.

User clicks 'Export' > 'Export ke Excel (.csv)': export all rows matching current criteria (not only current page) with Driver, Cycle 1-5 status + container, Order Status, SA Approved At and PO Number. If no row, display message no. 3. 'Print / PDF' prints the list.
User clicks 'Kolom': show / hide the checked columns (screen only).
[CR] Criteria Order Status: applied on [Find] together with the other criteria; [Clear] resets it to All.
[CR] User clicks [Waiting TM Approval (n)]: Order Status filter = Waiting TM Approval at once; click again to remove it. The counter is recalculated on every refresh of the list.
[CR] User clicks Edited = Y: open the TM Edit History popup of the order (all roles).
5.3 Order Detail
User clicks the Action icon: open Order Detail modal (Summary, Action, Cycle n sections, Status History).
Cycle sections are shown for every existing cycle, Cycle 1 first. Activity time blank is shown as 'Belum dilakukan'.

Files: 'View' Foto Surat Jalan enabled after Pickup Container; Finish Cycle Foto after Finish Cycle. 'Surat Jalan ELIPS' and 'PDF' enabled after Start Cycle. If pop-up is blocked when clicking 'PDF', display message no. 5.
Status History lists every status change and failed SA/PAS attempt, latest first.
Driver actions (Start Order, Pickup Container, Finish Cycle, Start Next Cycle, Finish Order) are done in the Driver App and are shown on this screen after Refresh.
5.4 Status Definition

rows: DTP created by Check & Submit (Planning Order screen)
IELP Admin assigns the order to a truck number, or LP Admin does Order Release (Reason, Driver)
Driver starts the order (Driver App), or LP Admin Pickup Container on Order Release
Driver scans Finish Order (Driver App) or LP Admin does Finish Order; VPLD TM can edit the delivery data and must approve; not yet visible in SA Approval
[CR] VPLD TM approved the Finish Order (5.6.9); data locked on this screen. Only orders in this status are listed in SA Approval
Order successfully processed to SA; SA timestamp saved
Order successfully processed to PAS and PO Number received
Cycle 1 created together with the DTP
Driver starts the order (Cycle 1) or starts the next cycle (Cycle 2, 3, ...)
Container picked up; Container Number recorded

operation.text: Container Number must be recorded on every cycle. Maximum 5 cycles per order (TBD, OP-07).
5.5 Status Transition Rules
An action is allowed only from the status below; otherwise display message no. 7. A role not listed gets message no. 8.

rows: Order Release (auto Start Cycle) or last cycle Finish Cycle (auto new cycle)
Start Daily Order + Finish Cycle, cycles < 5
Start Daily Order + last cycle Finish Cycle
Waiting TM Approval (data changed, edited by / date)
Finish Daily Order (approved by / date, locked)

operation.text: 5.6 Button Operation (Action Input modal)

Common for all actions on 'Submit': 1. If a mandatory field is blank, display message no. 6. Stop. 2. Check role and status (5.5); if not allowed, message no. 7 / 8. Stop. 3. Run the action validation below. 4. Update the order / cycle (Data Edit Mapping), insert status history (user, role, time, from/to status, reason, note), close the modal, refresh Order Detail and Order List and display message no. 10. If the record was changed by another user, display message no. 9.
5.6.1 Assign Truck (IELP Admin)

items: If the truck is not registered or not owned by the order Trucking Company, display message no. 11. Stop.
If truck license date < order date, display message no. 12. Stop.
If the truck is assigned to another order in Order Release / Start Daily Order with the same date and shift, display message no. 13. Stop.
Otherwise set Truck No and Order Status = Order Release.

operation.text: 5.6.2 Order Release (LP Admin) - Reason, Driver

items: If Reason has fewer than 10 characters, display message no. 14. Stop.
If the driver is not registered, inactive or not owned by the order supplier, display message no. 15. Stop.
If the order has no truck and the driver has no registered truck, display message no. 16. Stop.
Otherwise set Driver, Truck No (driver's registered truck when blank) and Order Status = Order Release.

operation.text: 5.6.3 Pickup Container (LP Admin) - Reason, Container Number

items: Reason check as 5.6.2 (message no. 14).
If Order Status is Order Release and Driver is blank, display message no. 21. Stop.
If the last cycle is Finish Cycle and the order already has 5 cycles, display message no. 22. Stop.
Container Number: not ISO 6346 format -> message no. 17; wrong check digit -> no. 18; used by another cycle of the same order -> no. 19; in Pickup Container on another order -> no. 20. Stop.
From Order Release: set Order Status = Start Daily Order and Cycle 1 Start Date = system date. After Finish Cycle: create the next cycle with Start Date = system date.
Set Container No, Cycle Status = Pickup Container, Pickup Date = system date.

operation.text: 5.6.4 Finish Cycle (LP Admin) - Reason

items: Reason check (message no. 14). If Container No of the cycle is blank, display message no. 23. Stop.
Set Cycle Status = Finish Cycle, Finish Date = system date.

operation.text: 5.6.5 Finish Order (LP Admin) - Reason

items: Reason check (message no. 14). If any cycle has no Container No, display message no. 23. Stop.

[CR] Set Order Status = Waiting TM Approval (was Finish Daily Order); finish data on the last cycle: FINISH_ORDER_DATE, FINISH_ORDER_BY, FINISH_BY_LP = 'Y'. If actual cycles < planned cycles, note 'Actual x of planned y cycles' in history (allowed, TBD OP-06).

operation.text: 5.6.6 Process to SA / Process to PAS (IELP Admin)

items: Process to SA: if any cycle is not Finish Cycle or has no Container No, display message no. 24. Stop. Send to SA; if failed, keep status, log failure (Logging no. 2) and display message no. 25. If successful, set Order Status = SA Approved and SA Approved Date.

Process to PAS: send to PAS; if no PO Number is returned, keep SA Approved, log failure (Logging no. 3) and display message no. 26. If PO Number format is invalid, display message no. 27. If successful, set Order Status = SA Approved with PO Number, PO Number and PO Received Date.
Whether SA / PAS is also run by a scheduled batch is TBD (OP-10).

operation.text: 5.6.7 [CR] Edit Finish Order (VPLD TM)

items: Open: [Edit] of a row or [Edit Finish Order] of the Order Detail (VPLD TM, Order Status Waiting TM Approval). The form shows the current data (driver scan, or the last TM edit) and remembers the VERSION.
Read-only part: No. Order, Date / Shift, Trucking Company, route, Order Status, Finished By. Editable fields: table 5.6.8. Edit Reason is mandatory.

[Save]: check all fields at once (Item Desc validation): mandatory, container format / check digit / duplicate / active elsewhere (messages no. 17-20), truck and driver master (messages no. 11, 12, 15), time order Start <= Pickup <= Finish, cycle n >= Finish of cycle n-1, Finish Order >= last Finish Cycle (message no. 41), no future time (message no. 42), Remarks <= 500, Edit Reason >= 10 characters (message no. 40). Errors are shown below the fields; nothing saved.
If no field differs from the current data, display message no. 43. Stop.
Otherwise show the confirmation (message no. 38) with the changed fields (Field, Cycle, Before, After) and the Edit Reason. [Back] returns to the form with the entered values.

[Confirm Save] - server: role VPLD TM (else message no. 35), Order Status still Waiting TM Approval (else message no. 34), VERSION unchanged (else message no. 36); then in one transaction update the order and cycles (Data Edit Mapping [CR] Edit blocks 13 / 14), set TM_EDIT_BY / TM_EDIT_DATE, VERSION + 1, insert the edit history (block 15, Log no. 8). Status is NOT changed.
Close the form, refresh the list (Edited = Y) and display message no. 39. Edit can be repeated until approval; every save adds one history row.

operation.text: 5.6.8 [CR] Editable fields (proposal - to be confirmed, OP-CR-01)

rows: No. Order, Date, Shift, Type, Renban, FA
Order key and DTP planning data (changed only in Planning Order / DTP Maintenance).
Vendor; PO and SA are per trucking company.
DTP Loc. From / To, route of every cycle
Defines Order Route and Total KM of SA Approval.
Planned cycle / number of actual cycles
Planning data; adding / removing a cycle is not part of this CR (OP-CR-01).
Wrong truck at login / scan. Registered truck of the same trucking company, license valid on the order date (messages no. 11 / 12).
Wrong driver. Registered, active driver of the same trucking company (message no. 15).
Typing error. Mandatory, ISO 6346 + check digit, unique in the order, not active in another order (messages no. 17-20).
Start Cycle / Pickup / Finish Cycle time (per cycle)
Actual times. Mandatory; Start <= Pickup <= Finish; Start of cycle n >= Finish of cycle n-1; not in the future (messages no. 41 / 42).
Actual finish. Mandatory; >= Finish Cycle time of the last cycle; not in the future (messages no. 41 / 42).
Optional note of TM, max 500 characters (ORDER_CYCLE.FINISH_REMARKS).
Why the data is changed; minimum 10 characters; stored in the edit history (message no. 40).
Order / Cycle Status, SA Number, PO Number, photos / files
Set by the system / Driver App.

operation.text: 5.6.9 [CR] Approve Finish Order (VPLD TM)

items: Open: [Approve] of a row, [Approve Finish Order] of the Order Detail, or [Approve Finish Order (n)] for the selected rows. If no row is selected, display message no. 37. Stop.

Show the confirmation (message no. 31) with No. Order, Trucking Comp., License Plate, Driver, Finish Scan, Finished By (Driver scan / LP Admin), Cycle (Act / Plan), Container No. of every cycle, Last Destination and Edited (Y with user / date, or N). Data is read only.
[Cancel]: close, no change. [Confirm Approve]: send the list (No. Order + VERSION shown) to the server.

Server, for every order: role VPLD TM (else message no. 35 for the whole request); Order Status still Waiting TM Approval (else message no. 34); VERSION equal to the displayed version (else message no. 36).

If any order fails, nothing is approved (all-or-nothing, one transaction): display message no. 33 with "<No. Order>: <reason>"; the modal stays open; failed rows are unselected and must be selected again after refresh. Log no. 7.

Otherwise for every order: Order Status = Finish Daily Order, TM_APPROVE_BY = login user, TM_APPROVE_DATE = server date-time, VERSION + 1 (Data Edit Mapping block 12), status history 'Approve Finish Order' (Log no. 1 / 6). Close, clear the selection, refresh list and counter, display message no. 32.

After approval the order is locked on this screen (no Edit / Approve). It now meets the SA Approval eligibility (Finish Daily Order, no SA Number); SA Approval uses the data after the TM edits. Orders Waiting TM Approval are never listed in SA Approval.

operation.text: 5.6.10 [CR] Open Points of the CR (not decided - default assumption used in this UISS)

rows: Final list of the fields VPLD TM may edit (table 5.6.8).
As table 5.6.8: License Plate, Driver, Container No. and Start / Pickup / Finish Cycle time per cycle, Finish Order time, Remarks. Route, cycles, planning data not editable.
Can VPLD TM reject / return the Finish Order to the driver (wrong scan)? Status after return, driver scans again?
No reject / return in this CR; wrong data is corrected with Edit.
Can VPLD TM finish an order manually when the driver did not scan (driver phone problem)? Mandatory data?
No. Manual Finish Order stays with LP Admin (Reason mandatory, 5.6.5); it then waits for TM edit / approval.
Is edit allowed after approval (e.g. until SA Approval)? What if SA Approval rejects?
No. After Approve the order is Finish Daily Order and locked on this screen; a correction after approval / SA rejection is outside this CR (TBD).
Bulk approve or per row only?
Both: [Approve] per row / Order Detail and [Approve Finish Order (n)] for the selected rows (all-or-nothing).
None. Orders stay Waiting TM Approval until approved.
Orders already Finish Daily Order before go-live of this CR?
They stay Finish Daily Order and go to SA Approval directly (TM columns empty).
Notification (e-mail / dashboard) to VPLD TM for orders waiting approval?
No notification; the [Waiting TM Approval (n)] counter on this screen only.
Edit history storage: dedicated history table or the existing activity log?
Existing ielp.LOG_ACTIVITY_ORDER (one row per save: ACT, REMARK = reason, PARAM_REQ / PARAM_RES = before / after JSON); no new table.
Should a TM edit of truck / driver / container be sent again to the Driver App?
No; the order is already finished in the APK (HISTORY).

operation.text: 5.7 Related Functions (separate UISS)

Daily Monitoring [+ Create DTP] dialog (IELP Admin, legacy - kept, decision G-DM-05) - DTP Check & Submit: Date, Type, Trucking Comp., Shift, From/To Loc., Renban (5 digits, unique per supplier + date + shift), Planned Cycle (1-5) mandatory; date not in the past; From <> To. Creates order Planning Order / DTP Creation Release.

Driver App - Login with User ID, Truck No. and truck license date: user ID registered and active, truck registered and owned by the driver supplier, license date equals master and not expired. Driver sees only orders of that truck; Start Order only when the truck has no other order in Start Daily Order.

Driver App - Start Order, Pickup Container (Container Number mandatory), Finish Cycle, Start Next Cycle, Finish Order follow the rules in 5.5 and 5.6 without Reason. [CR] Finish Order in the Driver App sets Order Status Waiting TM Approval (not Finish Daily Order); the order is finished only after the VPLD TM approval.
Database Specification (ELIPS AE070_ILS_DB)

Source of truth for tables / columns / types: docs/db/ELIPS_Schema.sql. No sample data was available: value lists and status codes are TBD. Status: Verified = UISS already matched the schema; Revised = changed to the schema in this revision; Revised (DCR) = existing application logic kept, the table needs the DB change request listed below; TBD = not confirmed.
Conflicts resolved (decision 14-Nov-26): existing application logic kept; DB change requests (DCR) where the table cannot hold it

items: G-DM-01 Order vs cycle: Existing logic kept: order header with up to 5 cycles; order = DTP_2_DETAIL row, cycle = ORDER_CYCLE row (CYCLE_SEQ). No DB change: mapping as stated.
G-DM-02 Status codes: Existing logic kept: order / cycle statuses of workflow.js (ORDER, CYCLE). DCR-24: Register the statuses in ielp.MS_STATUS - data, no column change.

G-DM-03 Status history columns: Existing logic kept: status history with from / to status, role, reason, note (workflow.js log). DCR-25: ADD ielp.LOG_ACTIVITY_ORDER.FROM_STS_CODE varchar(3), ROLE varchar(50).

G-DM-04 FA / planned cycle / PO received date: Existing logic kept: FA flag, planned cycles and PO received date on the order. DCR-26: ADD ielp.DTP_2_DETAIL.FA_FLAG varchar(1), PLANNED_CYCLE int; ADD ielp.ORDER_CYCLE.PO_RECEIVED_DATE datetime.

G-DM-06 [CR] TM edit / approval: edit and approval user / date are not in ELIPS. DCR-44: ADD ielp.DTP_2_DETAIL.TM_EDIT_BY varchar(500), TM_EDIT_DATE datetime, TM_APPROVE_BY varchar(500), TM_APPROVE_DATE datetime; new ielp.MS_STATUS row 'Waiting TM Approval' (code TBD). Edited data uses existing columns; edit history in the existing ielp.LOG_ACTIVITY_ORDER (OP-CR-09).

operation.text: Print / PDF (review addition, DM-05)

Menu Export > "Print / PDF" calls the browser print of the current list (app.js:326 window.print()); the printed content is the visible list with the active filters and columns. No server call, no database access.
Paper size, header / footer and page breaks follow the browser print settings - TBD - Not confirmed from existing schema/data/code.
Legacy Create DTP dialog (IELP Admin) - existing logic kept (decision G-DM-05)
The [+ Create DTP] button of Daily Monitoring (shown for IELP Admin, app.js:230) opens the dialog Date, Type, Trucking Comp., Shift, DTP Loc. From / To, Renban, Planned Cycle, FA (app.js:558).

[Check] validates with workflow.js checkDTP (rules in Item Desc); [Submit] creates one order with the first cycle in status Planning Order / DTP Creation Release and a history entry "DTP Check & Submit".

This path exists besides Planning Order (Planner VPLD, UISS DTP Creation); both are kept as implemented. It does not use KPI, Payment Type or the DTP queue (see docs/review/09 BUG-01, decision G-DM-05).
